_about: Output format for Agent 2 (Researcher). Works for any bill. Every claim needs a source URL. Use empty lists when nothing was found. Never guess.

expert_analysis.source_type: one of: crs_report | cbo_estimate | committee_report | government_agency | law_firm | trade_association | think_tank | advocacy_group | news
expert_analysis.title: string
expert_analysis.short_quote: string, 25 words or fewer, copied exactly

stakeholders.name: string
stakeholders.type: exactly one of: industry | consumer | labor | safety | environmental | government | other (companies and trade groups are industry; law firms and think tanks are other)

lobbying.notes: string. Filings show who is lobbying, not which side they are on.

comparable_past_laws.name: string
comparable_past_laws.jurisdiction: string, e.g. 'New York City' or 'US federal' or 'European Union'
comparable_past_laws.similarity: string, what it has in common with this bill

what_happened.effect: string, a measured or reported result

alternative_paths.path: one of: agency_rulemaking | state_or_local_laws | larger_package | executive_action | court_case | other
alternative_paths.description: string, how the same requirement could happen even if this bill fails

forecast_adjustments.factor: one of: admin_support | admin_opposition | floor_vote_scheduled | must_pass_package | member_hold | industry_opposition | broad_coalition | competing_bill
forecast_adjustments.multiplier: number, inside the range the instructions give for that factor
